text:
sofia_sales: Quick thread for PortoFinancial POC. They're asking: EU tenants must keep processing + caches inside EU even during incidents, list of Sao Paulo subprocessors + cert links, and a back-of-envelope hosted vs dedicated for 250 & 1k RPS.
diego_se: We have routing knobs to support this. Key flags: tenant_pin (true), allowed_regions (explicit list), failover_mode with options: region_fallback_only, degrade, or reject. For strict EU-only, set tenant_pin=true + failover_mode=region_fallback_only + on_no_capacity=reject.
luca_customer: They also asked whether any telemetry or debug logs ever include raw customer prompts and if those logs leave region.
nana_privacy: We can confirm that request-level logs containing raw prompts are redacted by default and never exported outside the tenant region when tenant_pin=true. Audit logs (metadata) may be aggregated to control plane but we can configure aggregation to EU-only for the POC.
rachel_infra: Sao Paulo subprocessors: GCP (sa-east1) - link to compliance page: https://compliance.gcp.example/sa-east1, LogKeeper (logs stored in sa-east1, SOC2 link: https://logkeeper.example/soc2), MetricsNow (metrics, ISO27001: https://metricsnow.example/iso27001). I'll generate a CSV. We do not currently run a dedicated BR-only cluster.
sofia_sales: Can the hosted POC be configured so backups and snapshots remain in-region? Customer wants no cross-border backups.
diego_se: Backups: primary backups of KV & metadata are configurable. For hosted POC we can request EU-only retention and disable cross-region backups. Note: control-plane metadata replication needs to be scoped; we can enable EU-only for tenant during POC. For production, Private deployment or Dedicated can provide stronger guarantees.
luca_customer: If EU capacity is exhausted, they will choose reject rather than cross-region. Can you implement a hard reject?
drigo_se: (typo) diego_se: Yes, on_no_capacity=reject returns 503 immediately. We also have an option to return a typed error to surface to app: {"code":"REGION_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED","message":"EU capacity exhausted"}.
nana_privacy: Support access: we can restrict SRE/support consoles to EU egress only for this tenant and require ticketed approval for any cross-region sessions. We log every access and can provide proof of review.
rachel_infra: Pricing sketch: Hosted with tenant_pin - no change to per-token pricing. If they want reserved capacity during the POC window we can arrange short-term reservations for a small uplift (rough: +15%). Dedicated sketches: 250 RPS ~ $35k/mo, 1000 RPS ~ $140k/mo. Model family and quantization still large levers. Will get more precise quote if they confirm model family.
sofia_sales: Please keep the numbers loose - customer wants order of magnitude. We'll attach a note saying exact quote follows.
luca_customer: Also: do you use any subprocessors for key management in Brazil? They require KMS within region for certain customers.
rachel_infra: Keys are customer-managed for Private deployments. For hosted we use cloud KMS in region when available. In sa-east1 we use GCP KMS, key material is in-region. For extra assurance we can offer Bring-Your-Own-Key for Dedicated/Private.
diego_se: Routing snippet for their POC (we tested this in staging):
```
routing_policy:
  tenant_pin: true
  allowed_regions: ["eu-west-1","eu-central-1"]
  failover_mode: "region_fallback_only"
  on_no_capacity: "reject"
```
sofia_sales: curl to create tenant with policy:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"porto-eu","region_pin":"eu-central-1","routing_policy":{"failover_mode":"region_fallback_only","on_no_capacity":"reject"}}'
```
sofia_sales: Action items: 1) rachel_infra: export subproc CSV + cert links for sa-east1 and attach SOC2/ISO docs; 2) ana_privacy: draft short LGPD + EU transfer addendum and support-access clause; 3) diego_se: validate routing snippet end-to-end in staging and confirm error payloads; 4) rachel_infra: ballpark dedicated numbers by model family (ETA EOD).
robo-deploy: POC org created: redwood-poc-porto-1930123456. Endpoint: https://eu.api.redwood.ai/poc/porto-eu. Credentials provisioned to secret-vault.
luca_customer: Thanks team. They will review CSV + DPA draft then confirm model family. If we can get SOC2 links for LogKeeper quickly that will help move legal.
sofia_sales: Will follow up with an email combining the CSV + routing snippet + DPA draft once we have drafts. Target to send by EOD.
(End of thread)
